'''Gossit's General Store''' was a general-purpose shop located in [[Isttu Village]] on board the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']]. It sold supplies for [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], except weapons, [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and [[Environment_suit/Legends|space suits]].
